settings.title: Trade Pricing
settings.description: Access exclusive trade pricing on our full range of 699+ dental laboratory products from leading European manufacturers.

settings.title: 30-Day Credit Terms
settings.description: Manage your cash flow with 30-day net credit terms (EOM) available to approved trade account holders.

settings.title: Dedicated Account Manager
settings.description: Your own dedicated account manager who knows your lab's needs and can help with product selection and ordering.

settings.title: Priority Shipping
settings.description: Trade account orders receive priority processing and dispatch. Same-day dispatch for orders placed before 2pm AEST.

settings.title: 24/7 Technical Support
settings.description: Round-the-clock access to our technical support team for product questions, application advice, and troubleshooting.

settings.title: Bulk Order Discounts
settings.description: Additional volume discounts available for large or regular orders. Contact your account manager to discuss custom pricing.

settings.hero_subtitle: Join hundreds of Australian dental laboratories who trust 3 Delta Dental as their preferred supplier. A trade account gives you exclusive pricing, flexible payment terms, and dedicated support.
settings.benefits_title: Everything You Need to Run Your Lab Efficiently
settings.benefits_subtitle: Trade accounts are designed for professional dental laboratories that require reliable supply, competitive pricing, and flexible payment options.
settings.steps_subtitle: Getting set up with a 3 Delta Dental trade account takes less than 5 minutes.
settings.step_1_description: Fill out the trade account application form below with your business details.
settings.step_2_description: Our team reviews your application and verifies your professional credentials.
settings.step_3_description: You receive login credentials and your trade pricing is applied to your account.
settings.step_4_description: Browse our full catalogue at trade prices with credit terms available.
settings.form_subtitle: Complete the form below. All fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. Applications are assessed within 2-3 business days.
settings.form_note_text: To embed your application form, paste the embed code from your form provider (e.g. Typeform, Google Forms, JotForm, or a Shopify form app) into the 'Form Custom Content' field. Once embedded, uncheck 'Show form embed instruction note'.
settings.contact_alt_text: Prefer to apply by phone or email? Contact us directly:
settings.eligibility_text: Trade accounts are available to verified dental industry professionals and businesses with an active ABN.
